verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers payroll reporting, benefits recording, PTO policy setup, Xero integration, and onboarding, but contains no mention of configuring multiple pay schedules (weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly) or assigning different schedules to different teams. Missing for 10: any documentation of pay schedule/frequency configuration, per-team or per-department schedule assignment, or an admin UI for managing multiple concurrent payroll cadences.
